# Code of Conduct

Xod is built by people who want a private, trustworthy AI on their own computers. We'd like working on it to feel the same way: safe, kind and useful.

## What we expect

- Be welcoming to newcomers. Every question is a fair question.
- Be respectful when you disagree. Argue about ideas, never about people.
- Give and take feedback gracefully, and assume good intent.
- Credit other people's work.

## What isn't okay

- Harassment, insults, or personal or political attacks.
- Sexualized language or imagery, and unwelcome attention of any kind.
- Publishing anyone's private information without their permission.
- Anything that would be inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Scope and enforcement

This applies in the repository, issues, discussions, and anywhere you represent the project. Maintainers may remove comments, commits or contributions that break it, and may block people who do so repeatedly.

To report a problem, contact the maintainers privately through the repository's **Security → Report a vulnerability** form (choose it even though it isn't a security issue; it's the private channel). Reports are kept confidential.

This code is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/), version 2.1.
